::: {.notes}
Cartesia identifies this MP3 as Sonic-3.6 in the English-US pair next to the support script. Its other player contains Eleven v3. The two models read identical words. The local file is the original MP3. The sample is US English. The 92% value describes the full US-English panel, not this individual recording.

The waveform shows peak absolute amplitude within equally spaced intervals of the playable course copy. Its time scale is in seconds.
